## New or updated card

<!-- One YAML file per card, based on a template from resources/templates/:
     - a project  -> cards/projects/<name>.yaml   (project-card.yaml)
     - a use case -> cards/use-cases/<name>.yaml  (use-case-card.yaml) -->

- [ ] I added/updated `cards/projects/<name>.yaml` **or** `cards/use-cases/<name>.yaml`
- [ ] Images are URLs or small files (< 1.5 MB) in the card type's `images/` folder
- [ ] Pictures show no personal data (names, e-mail addresses) and nothing copyrighted by others
- [ ] Project: `website` or `repo_url` is filled in; `demo_url` only if a working demo exists
- [ ] Use case: `main_area`, `challenge` and `proposed_ai` are filled in
- [ ] The "Validate cards" check is green
